bulbasaur.name: bulbasaur
bulbasaur.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

ivysaur.name: ivysaur
ivysaur.flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

venusaur.name: venusaur
venusaur.flavorText: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

charmander.name: charmander
charmander.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

charmeleon.name: charmeleon
charmeleon.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

charizard.name: charizard
charizard.flavorText: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

squirtle.name: squirtle
squirtle.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

wartortle.name: wartortle
wartortle.flavorText: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

blastoise.name: blastoise
blastoise.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

caterpie.name: caterpie
caterpie.flavorText: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

metapod.name: metapod
metapod.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

butterfree.name: butterfree
butterfree.flavorText: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

weedle.name: weedle
weedle.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

kakuna.name: kakuna
kakuna.flavorText: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

beedrill.name: beedrill
beedrill.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

pidgey.name: pidgey
pidgey.flavorText: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

pidgeotto.name: pidgeotto
pidgeotto.flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

pidgeot.name: pidgeot
pidgeot.flavorText: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

rattata.name: rattata
rattata.flavorText: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

raticate.name: raticate
raticate.flavorText: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

spearow.name: spearow
spearow.flavorText: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

fearow.name: fearow
fearow.flavorText: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

ekans.name: ekans
ekans.flavorText: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

arbok.name: arbok
arbok.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

pikachu.name: pikachu
pikachu.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

raichu.name: raichu
raichu.flavorText: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

sandshrew.name: sandshrew
sandshrew.flavorText: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

sandslash.name: sandslash
sandslash.flavorText: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

nidoran-f.name: nidoran-f
nidoran-f.flavorText: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

nidorina.name: nidorina
nidorina.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

nidoqueen.name: nidoqueen
nidoqueen.flavorText: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

nidoran-m.name: nidoran-m
nidoran-m.flavorText: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

nidorino.name: nidorino
nidorino.flavorText: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

nidoking.name: nidoking
nidoking.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

clefairy.name: clefairy
clefairy.flavorText: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

clefable.name: clefable
clefable.flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

vulpix.name: vulpix
vulpix.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

ninetales.name: ninetales
ninetales.flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

jigglypuff.name: jigglypuff
jigglypuff.flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

wigglytuff.name: wigglytuff
wigglytuff.flavorText: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

zubat.name: zubat
zubat.flavorText: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

golbat.name: golbat
golbat.flavorText: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

oddish.name: oddish
oddish.flavorText: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

gloom.name: gloom
gloom.flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

vileplume.name: vileplume
vileplume.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

paras.name: paras
paras.flavorText: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

parasect.name: parasect
parasect.flavorText: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

venonat.name: venonat
venonat.flavorText: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

venomoth.name: venomoth
venomoth.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

diglett.name: diglett
diglett.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

dugtrio.name: dugtrio
dugtrio.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

meowth.name: meowth
meowth.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

persian.name: persian
persian.flavorText: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

psyduck.name: psyduck
psyduck.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

golduck.name: golduck
golduck.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

mankey.name: mankey
mankey.flavorText: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

primeape.name: primeape
primeape.flavorText: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

growlithe.name: growlithe
growlithe.flavorText: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

arcanine.name: arcanine
arcanine.flavorText: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

poliwag.name: poliwag
poliwag.flavorText: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

poliwhirl.name: poliwhirl
poliwhirl.flavorText: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

poliwrath.name: poliwrath
poliwrath.flavorText: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

abra.name: abra
abra.flavorText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

kadabra.name: kadabra
kadabra.flavorText: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.

alakazam.name: alakazam
alakazam.flavorText: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.

machop.name: machop
machop.flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

machoke.name: machoke
machoke.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

machamp.name: machamp
machamp.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

bellsprout.name: bellsprout
bellsprout.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

weepinbell.name: weepinbell
weepinbell.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

victreebel.name: victreebel
victreebel.flavorText: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

tentacool.name: tentacool
tentacool.flavorText: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

tentacruel.name: tentacruel
tentacruel.flavorText: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

geodude.name: geodude
geodude.flavorText: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

graveler.name: graveler
graveler.flavorText: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

golem.name: golem
golem.flavorText: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

ponyta.name: ponyta
ponyta.flavorText: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

rapidash.name: rapidash
rapidash.flavorText: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

slowpoke.name: slowpoke
slowpoke.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

slowbro.name: slowbro
slowbro.flavorText: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

magnemite.name: magnemite
magnemite.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

magneton.name: magneton
magneton.flavorText: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

farfetchd.name: farfetchd
farfetchd.flavorText: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

doduo.name: doduo
doduo.flavorText: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

dodrio.name: dodrio
dodrio.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

seel.name: seel
seel.flavorText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

dewgong.name: dewgong
dewgong.flavorText: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

grimer.name: grimer
grimer.flavorText: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.

muk.name: muk
muk.flavorText: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

shellder.name: shellder
shellder.flavorText: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

cloyster.name: cloyster
cloyster.flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

gastly.name: gastly
gastly.flavorText: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

haunter.name: haunter
haunter.flavorText: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.

gengar.name: gengar
gengar.flavorText: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

onix.name: onix
onix.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

drowzee.name: drowzee
drowzee.flavorText: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

hypno.name: hypno
hypno.flavorText: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

krabby.name: krabby
krabby.flavorText: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

kingler.name: kingler
kingler.flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

voltorb.name: voltorb
voltorb.flavorText: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.

electrode.name: electrode
electrode.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

exeggcute.name: exeggcute
exeggcute.flavorText: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

exeggutor.name: exeggutor
exeggutor.flavorText: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

cubone.name: cubone
cubone.flavorText: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

marowak.name: marowak
marowak.flavorText: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

hitmonlee.name: hitmonlee
hitmonlee.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

hitmonchan.name: hitmonchan
hitmonchan.flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

lickitung.name: lickitung
lickitung.flavorText: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

koffing.name: koffing
koffing.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

weezing.name: weezing
weezing.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

rhyhorn.name: rhyhorn
rhyhorn.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.

rhydon.name: rhydon
rhydon.flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

chansey.name: chansey
chansey.flavorText: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

tangela.name: tangela
tangela.flavorText: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

kangaskhan.name: kangaskhan
kangaskhan.flavorText: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.

horsea.name: horsea
horsea.flavorText: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

seadra.name: seadra
seadra.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

goldeen.name: goldeen
goldeen.flavorText: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

seaking.name: seaking
seaking.flavorText: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

staryu.name: staryu
staryu.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

starmie.name: starmie
starmie.flavorText: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

mr-mime.name: mr-mime
mr-mime.flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

scyther.name: scyther
scyther.flavorText: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

jynx.name: jynx
jynx.flavorText: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

electabuzz.name: electabuzz
electabuzz.flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

magmar.name: magmar
magmar.flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

pinsir.name: pinsir
pinsir.flavorText: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.

tauros.name: tauros
tauros.flavorText: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

magikarp.name: magikarp
magikarp.flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

gyarados.name: gyarados
gyarados.flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

lapras.name: lapras
lapras.flavorText: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

ditto.name: ditto
ditto.flavorText: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

eevee.name: eevee
eevee.flavorText: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

vaporeon.name: vaporeon
vaporeon.flavorText: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

jolteon.name: jolteon
jolteon.flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

flareon.name: flareon
flareon.flavorText: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

porygon.name: porygon
porygon.flavorText: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial POKéMON.

omanyte.name: omanyte
omanyte.flavorText: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

omastar.name: omastar
omastar.flavorText: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

kabuto.name: kabuto
kabuto.flavorText: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

kabutops.name: kabutops
kabutops.flavorText: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.

aerodactyl.name: aerodactyl
aerodactyl.flavorText: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

snorlax.name: snorlax
snorlax.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

articuno.name: articuno
articuno.flavorText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

zapdos.name: zapdos
zapdos.flavorText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

moltres.name: moltres
moltres.flavorText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

dratini.name: dratini
dratini.flavorText: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

dragonair.name: dragonair
dragonair.flavorText: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

dragonite.name: dragonite
dragonite.flavorText: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

mewtwo.name: mewtwo
mewtwo.flavorText: A POKéMON whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

mew.name: mew
mew.flavorText: A POKéMON of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

chikorita.name: chikorita
chikorita.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

bayleef.name: bayleef
bayleef.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

meganium.name: meganium
meganium.flavorText: MEGANIUM’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cyndaquil.name: cyndaquil
cyndaquil.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

quilava.name: quilava
quilava.flavorText: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

typhlosion.name: typhlosion
typhlosion.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

totodile.name: totodile
totodile.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

croconaw.name: croconaw
croconaw.flavorText: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

feraligatr.name: feraligatr
feraligatr.flavorText: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

sentret.name: sentret
sentret.flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

furret.name: furret
furret.flavorText: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

hoothoot.name: hoothoot
hoothoot.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

noctowl.name: noctowl
noctowl.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

ledyba.name: ledyba
ledyba.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

ledian.name: ledian
ledian.flavorText: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

spinarak.name: spinarak
spinarak.flavorText: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

ariados.name: ariados
ariados.flavorText: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

crobat.name: crobat
crobat.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

chinchou.name: chinchou
chinchou.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

lanturn.name: lanturn
lanturn.flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

pichu.name: pichu
pichu.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cleffa.name: cleffa
cleffa.flavorText: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

igglybuff.name: igglybuff
igglybuff.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

togepi.name: togepi
togepi.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

togetic.name: togetic
togetic.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

natu.name: natu
natu.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

xatu.name: xatu
xatu.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

mareep.name: mareep
mareep.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

flaaffy.name: flaaffy
flaaffy.flavorText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

ampharos.name: ampharos
ampharos.flavorText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

bellossom.name: bellossom
bellossom.flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

marill.name: marill
marill.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

azumarill.name: azumarill
azumarill.flavorText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

sudowoodo.name: sudowoodo
sudowoodo.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

politoed.name: politoed
politoed.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

hoppip.name: hoppip
hoppip.flavorText: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

skiploom.name: skiploom
skiploom.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

jumpluff.name: jumpluff
jumpluff.flavorText: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

aipom.name: aipom
aipom.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

sunkern.name: sunkern
sunkern.flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

sunflora.name: sunflora
sunflora.flavorText: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

yanma.name: yanma
yanma.flavorText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

wooper.name: wooper
wooper.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

quagsire.name: quagsire
quagsire.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

espeon.name: espeon
espeon.flavorText: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.

umbreon.name: umbreon
umbreon.flavorText: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

murkrow.name: murkrow
murkrow.flavorText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

slowking.name: slowking
slowking.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

misdreavus.name: misdreavus
misdreavus.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

unown.name: unown
unown.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

wobbuffet.name: wobbuffet
wobbuffet.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

girafarig.name: girafarig
girafarig.flavorText: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

pineco.name: pineco
pineco.flavorText: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

forretress.name: forretress
forretress.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

dunsparce.name: dunsparce
dunsparce.flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

gligar.name: gligar
gligar.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

steelix.name: steelix
steelix.flavorText: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

snubbull.name: snubbull
snubbull.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

granbull.name: granbull
granbull.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

qwilfish.name: qwilfish
qwilfish.flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

scizor.name: scizor
scizor.flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

shuckle.name: shuckle
shuckle.flavorText: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

heracross.name: heracross
heracross.flavorText: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

sneasel.name: sneasel
sneasel.flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

teddiursa.name: teddiursa
teddiursa.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

ursaring.name: ursaring
ursaring.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

slugma.name: slugma
slugma.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

magcargo.name: magcargo
magcargo.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

swinub.name: swinub
swinub.flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

piloswine.name: piloswine
piloswine.flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

corsola.name: corsola
corsola.flavorText: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.

remoraid.name: remoraid
remoraid.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.

octillery.name: octillery
octillery.flavorText: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.

delibird.name: delibird
delibird.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

mantine.name: mantine
mantine.flavorText: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

skarmory.name: skarmory
skarmory.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

houndour.name: houndour
houndour.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.

houndoom.name: houndoom
houndoom.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

kingdra.name: kingdra
kingdra.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

phanpy.name: phanpy
phanpy.flavorText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

donphan.name: donphan
donphan.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

porygon2.name: porygon2
porygon2.flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

stantler.name: stantler
stantler.flavorText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

smeargle.name: smeargle
smeargle.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

tyrogue.name: tyrogue
tyrogue.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

hitmontop.name: hitmontop
hitmontop.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

smoochum.name: smoochum
smoochum.flavorText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

elekid.name: elekid
elekid.flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

magby.name: magby
magby.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.

miltank.name: miltank
miltank.flavorText: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

blissey.name: blissey
blissey.flavorText: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

raikou.name: raikou
raikou.flavorText: This POKéMON races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

entei.name: entei
entei.flavorText: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

suicune.name: suicune
suicune.flavorText: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

larvitar.name: larvitar
larvitar.flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

pupitar.name: pupitar
pupitar.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

tyranitar.name: tyranitar
tyranitar.flavorText: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

lugia.name: lugia
lugia.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

ho-oh.name: ho-oh
ho-oh.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

celebi.name: celebi
celebi.flavorText: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

treecko.name: treecko
treecko.flavorText: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

grovyle.name: grovyle
grovyle.flavorText: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

sceptile.name: sceptile
sceptile.flavorText: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

torchic.name: torchic
torchic.flavorText: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

combusken.name: combusken
combusken.flavorText: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

blaziken.name: blaziken
blaziken.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

mudkip.name: mudkip
mudkip.flavorText: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

marshtomp.name: marshtomp
marshtomp.flavorText: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

swampert.name: swampert
swampert.flavorText: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

poochyena.name: poochyena
poochyena.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

mightyena.name: mightyena
mightyena.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

zigzagoon.name: zigzagoon
zigzagoon.flavorText: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

linoone.name: linoone
linoone.flavorText: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

wurmple.name: wurmple
wurmple.flavorText: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

silcoon.name: silcoon
silcoon.flavorText: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

beautifly.name: beautifly
beautifly.flavorText: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

cascoon.name: cascoon
cascoon.flavorText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

dustox.name: dustox
dustox.flavorText: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

lotad.name: lotad
lotad.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

lombre.name: lombre
lombre.flavorText: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

ludicolo.name: ludicolo
ludicolo.flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO’s cells, making it more powerful.

seedot.name: seedot
seedot.flavorText: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

nuzleaf.name: nuzleaf
nuzleaf.flavorText: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

shiftry.name: shiftry
shiftry.flavorText: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

taillow.name: taillow
taillow.flavorText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

swellow.name: swellow
swellow.flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

wingull.name: wingull
wingull.flavorText: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

pelipper.name: pelipper
pelipper.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

ralts.name: ralts
ralts.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.

kirlia.name: kirlia
kirlia.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

gardevoir.name: gardevoir
gardevoir.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

surskit.name: surskit
surskit.flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

masquerain.name: masquerain
masquerain.flavorText: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

shroomish.name: shroomish
shroomish.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

breloom.name: breloom
breloom.flavorText: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

slakoth.name: slakoth
slakoth.flavorText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

vigoroth.name: vigoroth
vigoroth.flavorText: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.

slaking.name: slaking
slaking.flavorText: It is the world’s most slothful POKéMON. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

nincada.name: nincada
nincada.flavorText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

ninjask.name: ninjask
ninjask.flavorText: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

shedinja.name: shedinja
shedinja.flavorText: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

whismur.name: whismur
whismur.flavorText: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

loudred.name: loudred
loudred.flavorText: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

exploud.name: exploud
exploud.flavorText: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

makuhita.name: makuhita
makuhita.flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can withstand any attack.

hariyama.name: hariyama
hariyama.flavorText: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

azurill.name: azurill
azurill.flavorText: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

nosepass.name: nosepass
nosepass.flavorText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

skitty.name: skitty
skitty.flavorText: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

delcatty.name: delcatty
delcatty.flavorText: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

sableye.name: sableye
sableye.flavorText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

mawile.name: mawile
mawile.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

aron.name: aron
aron.flavorText: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

lairon.name: lairon
lairon.flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

aggron.name: aggron
aggron.flavorText: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

meditite.name: meditite
meditite.flavorText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

medicham.name: medicham
medicham.flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

electrike.name: electrike
electrike.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

manectric.name: manectric
manectric.flavorText: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

plusle.name: plusle
plusle.flavorText: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

minun.name: minun
minun.flavorText: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

volbeat.name: volbeat
volbeat.flavorText: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

illumise.name: illumise
illumise.flavorText: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

roselia.name: roselia
roselia.flavorText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

gulpin.name: gulpin
gulpin.flavorText: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

swalot.name: swalot
swalot.flavorText: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

carvanha.name: carvanha
carvanha.flavorText: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

sharpedo.name: sharpedo
sharpedo.flavorText: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

wailmer.name: wailmer
wailmer.flavorText: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

wailord.name: wailord
wailord.flavorText: It is among the largest of all POKéMON. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

numel.name: numel
numel.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

camerupt.name: camerupt
camerupt.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

torkoal.name: torkoal
torkoal.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

spoink.name: spoink
spoink.flavorText: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

grumpig.name: grumpig
grumpig.flavorText: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

spinda.name: spinda
spinda.flavorText: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

trapinch.name: trapinch
trapinch.flavorText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

vibrava.name: vibrava
vibrava.flavorText: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

flygon.name: flygon
flygon.flavorText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

cacnea.name: cacnea
cacnea.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cacturne.name: cacturne
cacturne.flavorText: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

swablu.name: swablu
swablu.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

altaria.name: altaria
altaria.flavorText: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.

zangoose.name: zangoose
zangoose.flavorText: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

seviper.name: seviper
seviper.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

lunatone.name: lunatone
lunatone.flavorText: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

solrock.name: solrock
solrock.flavorText: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

barboach.name: barboach
barboach.flavorText: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

whiscash.name: whiscash
whiscash.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

corphish.name: corphish
corphish.flavorText: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

crawdaunt.name: crawdaunt
crawdaunt.flavorText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

baltoy.name: baltoy
baltoy.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

claydol.name: claydol
claydol.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

lileep.name: lileep
lileep.flavorText: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

cradily.name: cradily
cradily.flavorText: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

anorith.name: anorith
anorith.flavorText: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

armaldo.name: armaldo
armaldo.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

feebas.name: feebas
feebas.flavorText: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

milotic.name: milotic
milotic.flavorText: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

castform.name: castform
castform.flavorText: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

kecleon.name: kecleon
kecleon.flavorText: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

shuppet.name: shuppet
shuppet.flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

banette.name: banette
banette.flavorText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

duskull.name: duskull
duskull.flavorText: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

dusclops.name: dusclops
dusclops.flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

tropius.name: tropius
tropius.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

chimecho.name: chimecho
chimecho.flavorText: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

absol.name: absol
absol.flavorText: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

wynaut.name: wynaut
wynaut.flavorText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

snorunt.name: snorunt
snorunt.flavorText: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

glalie.name: glalie
glalie.flavorText: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

spheal.name: spheal
spheal.flavorText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

sealeo.name: sealeo
sealeo.flavorText: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

walrein.name: walrein
walrein.flavorText: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

clamperl.name: clamperl
clamperl.flavorText: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

huntail.name: huntail
huntail.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

gorebyss.name: gorebyss
gorebyss.flavorText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

relicanth.name: relicanth
relicanth.flavorText: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

luvdisc.name: luvdisc
luvdisc.flavorText: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

bagon.name: bagon
bagon.flavorText: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

shelgon.name: shelgon
shelgon.flavorText: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

salamence.name: salamence
salamence.flavorText: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

beldum.name: beldum
beldum.flavorText: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

metang.name: metang
metang.flavorText: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.

metagross.name: metagross
metagross.flavorText: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

regirock.name: regirock
regirock.flavorText: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

regice.name: regice
regice.flavorText: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

registeel.name: registeel
registeel.flavorText: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

latias.name: latias
latias.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

latios.name: latios
latios.flavorText: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

kyogre.name: kyogre
kyogre.flavorText: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

groudon.name: groudon
groudon.flavorText: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

rayquaza.name: rayquaza
rayquaza.flavorText: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

jirachi.name: jirachi
jirachi.flavorText: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

deoxys.name: deoxys
deoxys.flavorText: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

turtwig.name: turtwig
turtwig.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

grotle.name: grotle
grotle.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

torterra.name: torterra
torterra.flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA’s back and spend their entire life there.

chimchar.name: chimchar
chimchar.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

monferno.name: monferno
monferno.flavorText: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

infernape.name: infernape
infernape.flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

piplup.name: piplup
piplup.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

prinplup.name: prinplup
prinplup.flavorText: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

empoleon.name: empoleon
empoleon.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

starly.name: starly
starly.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

staravia.name: staravia
staravia.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.

staraptor.name: staraptor
staraptor.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

bidoof.name: bidoof
bidoof.flavorText: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.

bibarel.name: bibarel
bibarel.flavorText: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

kricketot.name: kricketot
kricketot.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

kricketune.name: kricketune
kricketune.flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

shinx.name: shinx
shinx.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

luxio.name: luxio
luxio.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

luxray.name: luxray
luxray.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

budew.name: budew
budew.flavorText: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.

roserade.name: roserade
roserade.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cranidos.name: cranidos
cranidos.flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

rampardos.name: rampardos
rampardos.flavorText: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

shieldon.name: shieldon
shieldon.flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

bastiodon.name: bastiodon
bastiodon.flavorText: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

burmy.name: burmy
burmy.flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

wormadam.name: wormadam
wormadam.flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

mothim.name: mothim
mothim.flavorText: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.

combee.name: combee
combee.flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

vespiquen.name: vespiquen
vespiquen.flavorText: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.

pachirisu.name: pachirisu
pachirisu.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

buizel.name: buizel
buizel.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

floatzel.name: floatzel
floatzel.flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

cherubi.name: cherubi
cherubi.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.

cherrim.name: cherrim
cherrim.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

shellos.name: shellos
shellos.flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

gastrodon.name: gastrodon
gastrodon.flavorText: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

ambipom.name: ambipom
ambipom.flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.

drifloon.name: drifloon
drifloon.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”

drifblim.name: drifblim
drifblim.flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

buneary.name: buneary
buneary.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

lopunny.name: lopunny
lopunny.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

mismagius.name: mismagius
mismagius.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

honchkrow.name: honchkrow
honchkrow.flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

glameow.name: glameow
glameow.flavorText: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.

purugly.name: purugly
purugly.flavorText: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

chingling.name: chingling
chingling.flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

stunky.name: stunky
stunky.flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

skuntank.name: skuntank
skuntank.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

bronzor.name: bronzor
bronzor.flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

bronzong.name: bronzong
bronzong.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

bonsly.name: bonsly
bonsly.flavorText: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.

mime-jr.name: mime-jr
mime-jr.flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

happiny.name: happiny
happiny.flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

chatot.name: chatot
chatot.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

spiritomb.name: spiritomb
spiritomb.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

gible.name: gible
gible.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

gabite.name: gabite
gabite.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

garchomp.name: garchomp
garchomp.flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

munchlax.name: munchlax
munchlax.flavorText: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

riolu.name: riolu
riolu.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

lucario.name: lucario
lucario.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

hippopotas.name: hippopotas
hippopotas.flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

hippowdon.name: hippowdon
hippowdon.flavorText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

skorupi.name: skorupi
skorupi.flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

drapion.name: drapion
drapion.flavorText: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

croagunk.name: croagunk
croagunk.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

toxicroak.name: toxicroak
toxicroak.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

carnivine.name: carnivine
carnivine.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.

finneon.name: finneon
finneon.flavorText: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

lumineon.name: lumineon
lumineon.flavorText: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.

mantyke.name: mantyke
mantyke.flavorText: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.

snover.name: snover
snover.flavorText: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

abomasnow.name: abomasnow
abomasnow.flavorText: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

weavile.name: weavile
weavile.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

magnezone.name: magnezone
magnezone.flavorText: A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.

lickilicky.name: lickilicky
lickilicky.flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

rhyperior.name: rhyperior
rhyperior.flavorText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

tangrowth.name: tangrowth
tangrowth.flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

electivire.name: electivire
electivire.flavorText: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.

magmortar.name: magmortar
magmortar.flavorText: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

togekiss.name: togekiss
togekiss.flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.

yanmega.name: yanmega
yanmega.flavorText: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

leafeon.name: leafeon
leafeon.flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

glaceon.name: glaceon
glaceon.flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

gliscor.name: gliscor
gliscor.flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

mamoswine.name: mamoswine
mamoswine.flavorText: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

porygon-z.name: porygon-z
porygon-z.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

gallade.name: gallade
gallade.flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

probopass.name: probopass
probopass.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

dusknoir.name: dusknoir
dusknoir.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

froslass.name: froslass
froslass.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

rotom.name: rotom
rotom.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

uxie.name: uxie
uxie.flavorText: When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

mesprit.name: mesprit
mesprit.flavorText: When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

azelf.name: azelf
azelf.flavorText: When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

dialga.name: dialga
dialga.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.

palkia.name: palkia
palkia.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.

heatran.name: heatran
heatran.flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

regigigas.name: regigigas
regigigas.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

giratina.name: giratina
giratina.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cresselia.name: cresselia
cresselia.flavorText: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

phione.name: phione
phione.flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

manaphy.name: manaphy
manaphy.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

darkrai.name: darkrai
darkrai.flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

shaymin.name: shaymin
shaymin.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

arceus.name: arceus
arceus.flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

victini.name: victini
victini.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

snivy.name: snivy
snivy.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

servine.name: servine
servine.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

serperior.name: serperior
serperior.flavorText: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

tepig.name: tepig
tepig.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

pignite.name: pignite
pignite.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

emboar.name: emboar
emboar.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

oshawott.name: oshawott
oshawott.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

dewott.name: dewott
dewott.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

samurott.name: samurott
samurott.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

patrat.name: patrat
patrat.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

watchog.name: watchog
watchog.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

lillipup.name: lillipup
lillipup.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

herdier.name: herdier
herdier.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

stoutland.name: stoutland
stoutland.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

purrloin.name: purrloin
purrloin.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

liepard.name: liepard
liepard.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

pansage.name: pansage
pansage.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

simisage.name: simisage
simisage.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

pansear.name: pansear
pansear.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

simisear.name: simisear
simisear.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

panpour.name: panpour
panpour.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

simipour.name: simipour
simipour.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

munna.name: munna
munna.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

musharna.name: musharna
musharna.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

pidove.name: pidove
pidove.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

tranquill.name: tranquill
tranquill.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

unfezant.name: unfezant
unfezant.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

blitzle.name: blitzle
blitzle.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

zebstrika.name: zebstrika
zebstrika.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

roggenrola.name: roggenrola
roggenrola.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

boldore.name: boldore
boldore.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

gigalith.name: gigalith
gigalith.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

woobat.name: woobat
woobat.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

swoobat.name: swoobat
swoobat.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

drilbur.name: drilbur
drilbur.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

excadrill.name: excadrill
excadrill.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

audino.name: audino
audino.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

timburr.name: timburr
timburr.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

gurdurr.name: gurdurr
gurdurr.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

conkeldurr.name: conkeldurr
conkeldurr.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

tympole.name: tympole
tympole.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

palpitoad.name: palpitoad
palpitoad.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

seismitoad.name: seismitoad
seismitoad.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

throh.name: throh
throh.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

sawk.name: sawk
sawk.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

sewaddle.name: sewaddle
sewaddle.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

swadloon.name: swadloon
swadloon.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

leavanny.name: leavanny
leavanny.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

venipede.name: venipede
venipede.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

whirlipede.name: whirlipede
whirlipede.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

scolipede.name: scolipede
scolipede.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

cottonee.name: cottonee
cottonee.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

whimsicott.name: whimsicott
whimsicott.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

petilil.name: petilil
petilil.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

lilligant.name: lilligant
lilligant.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

basculin.name: basculin
basculin.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

sandile.name: sandile
